about_the_game:
🐵 Funky Monkey: Time to Slack Off! (Demo Version)

Every tap you make stacks up fate points for your monkey.
It excitedly mimics your keyboard tapping—just to earn shinier hats, trendy outfits, and cool desktop decorations!

This is an exclusive early demo—more wild accessories and fun gameplay are brewing behind the scenes.
The full version is coming soon, so stay tuned!

🧰 Handpicked Accessories — Unlock Early

In the demo, you get access to some of the hottest accessories:
● 🧢 Hats
● 👗 Outfits
● 🖼 Desktop Decorations

Earn coins by playing, and freely trade them for your favorite gear to create your one-of-a-kind desktop monkey!
The coin shop and accessory recycling features are fully unlocked, letting you enjoy collecting and upgrading.

🌟 Core Demo Features

● Mix and match freely
Try out a variety of handpicked accessories and get a feel for the dress-up fun.
Adjust your monkey’s size and position to easily craft a unique desktop space.

● Real-time interactive desktop pet
With every click and keystroke, your monkey reacts with energy—keeping you company while you slack off.

🐒 Give your fingertips to the monkey—never stop!

Jump into Funky Monkey: Time to Slack Off! now,
start your collection and styling journey, and help your monkey evolve in style!
Remember, every click is for the monkey!
